reference.scope: Current transferred NLS behavior before removal; original Linux source provenance remains in isofs-linux-baseline.json and fat-linux-baseline.json.

domain.encode: BMP scalar values excluding NUL/surrogates (63487 units per available charset)
domain.decode: All one/two-byte inputs excluding leading NUL; EUC-JP additionally all 0x8f-prefixed two-byte suffixes. Compares one-character result and consumed count, not buffer text.
domain.joliet_changed: Number of input BMP units with different resulting Unicode after encode/fallback/decode; may include newly representable characters.
domain.lower: All 256 CP437 byte lowercasing outcomes; zero Linux case entries mean retain original byte.
